lake.motion: Small staggered ripples, stationary base, no bulk current

river.motion: Advected local highlights following channel direction and bends

waterfall.motion: Downward curtain, animated impact foam, droplets and outward pool ripples

sea.motion: Broad travelling wave fronts and swells
sea.shore: Breaking surf, foam advance and retreat

rule: Shared tile topology does not imply interchangeable motion. Never publish lake frames as river, waterfall or sea animation.
